messages.subject: 25% range residency?
parts:
Hello,
I wanted to reach out for clarification on the potential for only 20% of my birds having variograms with asymptotes. I tagged 20 birds, and after 1 year, only 4 have variograms that show range residency distributions. 

Is there a potential shortfall with this method of determining residency? I find it difficult to believe that of the 20 adult birds I tagged, only 20% are residents. I tagged only adults of a large non-migratory species that can move over large spatial scales. How do we handle this in terms of using ctmm akde for home range estimates?

Thank you.

messages.author: 40fd627580dd34f5
messages.subject: Re: 25% range residency?
parts:
Hi Noah,

The pitfall is that it's a subjective method. Feel free to post examples for everyone to see and evaluate.

But even non-migratory individuals could be taking up residence in different areas in different times of the year. E.g., breeding, rearing, etc..

Best,
Chris
